title: Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2611.21535v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. translated_title: 评估大语言模型在西班牙语政治话语中的文化推理能力与稳健性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被用于解读、生成和调解面向公众的语言，这使得它们的可靠性在政治敏感场景中尤为重要。尽管情感分析是该领域的常见任务，但社交媒体话语中的情感含义往往通过植根于特定文化、语用上含蓄间接的线索来传达，而仅以标签为中心的评估方式难以充分捕捉这些线索。在本文中，我们评估了大语言模型对社交媒体上西班牙语政治话语进行情感分析的稳健性，重点关注植根于文化的情感解读。我们提出了一种诊断协议，该协议将三个独立的人工标注视角整合为金标准子集和歧义子集，并通过基于模型条件困惑度和“LLM作为裁判”标准筛选出的情感翻转反事实样本，构建了一个合成子集以扩展语料库。利用该框架，我们对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种结合三重独立人工标注视角与基于情感翻转反事实构建合成子集的诊断协议，用以评估大语言模型在西班牙语政治话语中文化敏感的情感分析任务上的稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views with a synthetic subset of sentiment-flipped counterfactuals to evaluate LLM robustness in culturally situated sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse.
